title: Investigation of police criminal intelligence unit oversight
summary: On October 13, a motion was made to place Chief John Pelletier on paid administrative leave, effective that day, while the commission's independent investigation into his oversight of the criminal intelligence unit is pending. The commission had first put him on paid leave October 7 and made the deputy chief acting chief. In August, it approved hiring an investigator.

timeline.text: The deputy chief said the previous commission did not place Chief Pelletier on leave for the CIU (criminal intelligence unit) investigation.
The commission's independent investigation into the chief's oversight of the criminal intelligence unit is pending.
A motion was made to place Chief John Pelletier on paid administrative leave, effective today, while the investigation is pending.
Motion to authorize the chair to act as spokesperson: The commission made the chair its spokesperson on this matter.
Motion to authorize the chair to send notice letters: The commission let the chair send a letter telling the chief of the leave and telling the deputy chief he will be acting chief.

Motion on a point person for the independent investigator: The commission directed the acting chief to name an assistant chief as the department's contact for records the independent investigator requests.
Motion to appoint the deputy chief as acting chief: The commission made the deputy chief acting chief while the chief is on leave.
The deputy chief said he would rather the chief not be on leave but will take on the duties.
Motion to place the police chief on paid administrative leave: The commission placed the police chief on paid administrative leave, effective that day, while its independent investigation is pending.
It will also look at how the chief responded when he learned of the unit's issues.
The investigation will look at oversight of the police criminal intelligence unit.
Hiring of an investigator and scope of the investigation: The commission approved hiring an investigator, with a scope to be outlined by corporation counsel.
The commission will bring its unpaid leave suggestion to the administration.
Suggestion to put a lieutenant on administrative leave without pay: The commission voted to suggest that a lieutenant be put on administrative leave without pay.
